scoring_justification: Full recompute from raw simulation outputs is infeasible in the verifier sandbox, so we use result-level comparison against the paper's published values with absolute tolerances. This is effectively consistency scoring across multiple data points.

hidden_assets.purpose: gold lattice parameters and band gaps for anhydrous and hydrous forsterite
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table 1 and text, specifically the reported values for anhydrous lattice at each pressure and band gaps at 0 and 16 GPa, and hydrous band gaps for free proton orientations.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Values are directly taken from the paper's published numbers.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the actual paper-reported results; fabricating them would defeat reproduction benchmarking.

outputs.description: Optimized lattice constants and cell volume of anhydrous forsterite at pressures 0–12 GPa. Correspondence to paper Table 1.
Band gap energy of anhydrous forsterite at 0 and 16 GPa. Correspondence to paper Fig. 1 trend endpoints.
Band gap energy of hydrous forsterite (free proton model) along three orientations. Correspondence to paper-reported values.

output_contract.notes: All scored artifacts are compared to the original paper's published values with domain-appropriate tolerances. The workflow uses open-source DFT tools; the exact pseudopotential choice may shift values, which is accommodated by the tolerances. The scoring policy is reference_match: numeric values must fall within absolute tolerances around the hidden gold.
